rec.name: Spacer (Adjustable Vertical Whitespace Section)
rec.status: Built — QA passed, documented in Slite

what.text: A global, theme-editor section that inserts a blank vertical gap between two other sections on any page. The ticket has no description or spec. The name and context suggest a simple layout utility, so this is inferred rather than documented.

why.text: Whitespace separates content groups, reduces visual clutter and guides the eye from one message to the next. This can slightly improve scannability and perceived quality. It does not lift conversion directly, but it lets test variants fine-tune rhythm and grouping without custom CSS.

how.text: Add the Spacer section from the theme editor (Sectionfy library) between two existing sections and set its height. The ticket confirms the section was built, tested in the 'Sectionfy DEMO' store under Sections, and passed the Sectionfy quality check. A duplicate version of the section was also built; after agreement with Max, the version the developer built is the one that counts.

items: Spacer height (likely separate desktop and mobile values) — inferred, not confirmed in source
Optional background color to match the surrounding sections — inferred, not confirmed in source

dependencies.text: Sectionfy section framework and a theme that supports sections on the target page. No metafields or apps are mentioned. Documentation lives in Slite (CRO | Global | Spacer); a product image for the docs and the Pitch product catalog was still requested.

items: Scroll depth and section visibility on pages using the spacer
Conversion rate and click-through on neighboring sections (A/B variants with and without spacing)
Bounce rate / engagement on pages where spacing was changed
